lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਜਨਮ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਖਾਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh lobh biaapio janam hee kee khaan ||
lines.translation: Engrossed in unfulfilled sexual desire, unresolved anger and greed, you shall be consigned to reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਉਧਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਨਿ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: patit paavan saran aaio udhar naanak jaan ||2||12||31||
lines.translation: But I have entered the Sanctuary of the Purifier of sinners. O Nanak, I know that I shall be saved. ||2||12||31||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
I gaze on the Lotus-like Face of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਸਭ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: khojat khojat ratan paaio bisaree sabh chi(n)d ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Searching and seeking, I have found the Jewel. I am totally rid of all anxiety. ||1||Pause||
Enshrining His Lotus Feet within my heart,
pain and wickedness have been dispelled. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਧਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਰਬਸੋ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaj dhan paravaar merai sarabaso gobi(n)d ||
lines.translation: The Lord of all the Universe is my kingdom, wealth and family.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਮਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਮਰੰਦ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gam laabh paaio naanak phir na mara(n)d ||2||13||32||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak has earned the Profit; he shall never die again. ||2||13||32||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Worship God, and adore His Name.
Grasp the Feet of the Guru, the True Guru.
The Unfathomable Lord shall come into your mind,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤੋ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾਧਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jag jeeto ho ho gur kirapaadh ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: and by Guru's Grace, you shall be victorious in this world. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪੂਜਾ ਮੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਖੋਜੀ ਸਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik poojaa mai bahu bidh khojee saa poojaa j har bhaavaas ||
lines.translation: I have studied countless ways of worship in all sorts of ways, but that alone is worship, which is pleasing to the Lord's Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਟੀ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਪੁਤਰੀ ਜੋਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਏਹ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: maatee kee ih putaree joree kiaa eh karam kamaas ||
lines.translation: This body-puppet is made of clay - what can it do by itself?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: prabh baah pakar jis maarag paavahu so tudh ja(n)t milaas ||1||
lines.translation: O God, those humble beings meet You, whom You grasp by the arm, and place on the Path. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਇਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਆਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: avar ot mai koi na soojhai ik har kee ot mai aas ||
lines.translation: I do not know of any other support; O Lord, You are my only Hope and Support.
I am meek and poor - what prayer can I offer?
God abides in every heart.
My mind is thirsty for the Feet of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak daas kaheeat hai tumhraa hau bal bal sad bal jaas ||2||1||33||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak, Your slave, speaks: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||1||33||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Your Name, O my Beloved, is the Saving Grace of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nav nidh naam nidhaan har kerai ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is the wealth of the nine treasures.
One who is imbued with the Love of the Incomparably Beautiful Lord is joyful.
O mind, why do you cling to emotional attachments?
With your eyes, gaze upon the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਲੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: so paavai jis likhat lilerai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: They alone find it, who have such destiny inscribed upon their foreheads. ||1||Pause||
I serve at the feet of the Holy Saints.
I long for the dust of their feet, which purifies and sanctifies.
Just like the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, it washes away filth and pollution.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੋਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saas saas dhiaavahu mukh nahee morai ||
lines.translation: With each and every breath I meditate on Him, and never turn my face away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kichh sa(n)g na chaalai laakh karorai ||
lines.translation: Of your thousands and millions, nothing shall go along with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਪੁਕਰੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: prabh jee ko naam a(n)t pukarorai ||1||
lines.translation: Only the Name of God will call to you in the end. ||1||
Let it be your wish to honor and obey the One Formless Lord.
Abandon the love of everything else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਕਹਾਂ ਹਉ ਗੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਤੇਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kavan kahaa(n) hau gun pri terai ||
lines.translation: What Glorious Praises of Yours can I utter, O my Beloved?
I cannot describe even one of Your Virtues.
My mind is so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਵ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਕੇਰੈ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: mil naanak dev jagat gur kerai ||2||1||34||
lines.translation: Please come and meet Nanak, O Divine Guru of the World. ||2||1||34||
